analyst_view.overall: Early view: Albacete have won three in a row under Joseba Etxeberria, who replaced Alberto González in early October per one report, the latest a 3-1 win at Leganés, but they are still 21st. Celta Fortuna, Celta's reserve side, are 16th with a long absence list: one report names five injured players (Gavián, Somuah, Óscar Marcos, Anxo Rodríguez, Olmedo) and the site adds three yellow-card bans (Joel López, Enrique Ribes, Adrià Capdevila). This Monday-night game closes round 14.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.3 goals, which is high but fits the context: Celta Fortuna lost 5-1 at Girona, conceded twice at Burgos and against Córdoba, and will field a patched-up defence again. Against that, Higinio Marín, who scored Albacete's penalty at Leganés, went off injured and José Corpas is still serving a three-match ban, so I hold at the site's figure.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.1 corners, with 6.4 for Albacete. I lean lower: Etxeberria's Albacete have been winning by scoring early and defending, not by dominating, with only five shots in their win over Sabadell and 12 to Leganés's 17. Celta Fortuna will probably have more of the ball than the split suggests.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.5 cards. I lean higher: Albacete press high under Etxeberria, which brings fouls, Corpas was sent off two games ago, and three Celta Fortuna players have already reached five yellows. A Monday-night game between 21st and 16th should be scrappy.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.2 shots. I lean lower, mainly on Albacete's side: they have been outshot in their recent wins, and 16.2 home shots does not match how they play under Etxeberria. Celta Fortuna, who took 17 shots at home to Córdoba, can contribute their share.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.4 shots on target. I lean lower with the shots: Albacete's wins have come from few attempts (both of their goals against Sabadell went in off opponents), and Celta Fortuna's attack is short of options with Óscar Marcos, one of their top scorers, injured.
